flags.why: “Lang” describes a coat with white patches, whereas “roan” describes intermingled white and coloured hairs ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=lang)).
flags.fix: piebald; having white patches (of an animal's coat)

flags.why: “Nhiên nhi” is a Classical Chinese expression and is not a natural conjunction in the otherwise modern Vietnamese example.
flags.fix: Ông vẫn giữ tinh thần “bần nhi lạc”. = He maintained the spirit of being poor yet happy.

flags.why: “Len” is not an established Southern Vietnamese word for a traffic lane ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-len)).
This meaning is used across Vietnam, including in Northern reporting, so the Southern tag is misleading ([example](https://vietnamnet.vn/sao-chay-so-lam-tu-thien-hay-danh-bong-ten-tuoi-99632.html)).
